## The Story of VS Code: World Premiere

Discover the story behind VS Code, from its early beginnings to the platform millions of developers use today, and the community that helped shape it along the way.

**[Premiere: September 4 at 8:00 AM PT. Join us!](https://aka.ms/the-story-of-vs-code)**

[![Graphic poster featuring the VS Code logo glowing over a dark background filled with programming code, with the title "The Story of VS Code."](images/1_136/the-story-of-vs-code.png)](https://aka.ms/vscode-trailer)
